1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based electronic control unit arranged to modulate the first and second valves based on real-time feedback from sensors to achieve anti-lock braking functionality__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least two__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves __that are independently controlled by the control means__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger and smaller valves are configured to operate in a coordinated manner to achieve modulated braking pressure control__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, __and wherein the one or more larger valves are arranged to operate at lower speeds for coarse pressure adjustment__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __solenoid actuators that are pulse-width modulated by the control means__ [[binary actuators]].

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from __both__ a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __and to dynamically adjust valve operation based on the combined input from both sensors__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __wherein the reference data is stored in a non-volatile memory within the control means and is updated based on real-time vehicle operating conditions__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means continuously monitors wheel slip and adjusts valve modulation to maintain optimal wheel slip ratios__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the pump is controlled by the control means of the air braking unit to maintain optimal pressure in the storage tank based on system demand__.
